lede: Redcat Racing sells ready-to-run radio-controlled crawlers, monster trucks, trail trucks and hopping lowriders, plus spare and upgrade parts, from redcatracing.com and through hobby shops. Here's what it sells, what its policies say, and who it suits.

parts: Redcat Racing is a real RC car company based in Phoenix, Arizona. Its own giveaway page says Redcat turned 20 on May 5, 2025, and the company behind it is Namero LLC, doing business as Redcat Racing. Vehicles come ready to run with a radio, battery and charger, prices start around $120, and they carry a one-year limited warranty. Returns are 30 days, for unused items only, and you pay the return shipping.

Rock crawlers in 1/18 and 1/10 scale (Ascent-18, Everest, Ascent Fusion), monster trucks (Volcano-16, Volcano EPX), trail trucks such as the Gen 9 International Harvester Scout 800A, and hopping lowriders with officially licensed Chevrolet bodies (SixtyFour, SixtyFour-18, Monte Carlo). The store also sells batteries, chargers, replacement parts and hop-up upgrades for its vehicles, with user manuals and parts lists to download.
When we checked, the Volcano-16 cost $119.95, the Ascent-18 $129.99, the Everest Gen7 Sport $229.95, the Monte Carlo $419.99 and the 1/10 SixtyFour $549.99.
Choosing a 1/18 crawler? Our [Redcat Ascent-18 vs Ascent-18 APEX guide](saving-tips-redcat-ascent-18-vs-apex.html) compares the brushed and brushless models side by side, with prices and specs.

parts: Because Redcat's store doesn't publish customer ratings, we can't give you a score from it, and we won't make one up. What the store does show is a lot of support material: manuals, standard parts lists and hop-up parts for each vehicle, plus a warranty claim form. Before a big purchase such as the SixtyFour, look for owner reviews of that exact model on RC forums or retailer pages, and read the return terms below.

Yes. redcatracing.com lists a street address in Phoenix, Arizona, a phone number and sales and support emails, publishes its refund policy and terms, runs a dealer program for hobby shops, and has sold the SixtyFour lowrider since November 2020, by its own account. Warranty claims go to Redcat directly, not to the hobby shop that sold you the vehicle.

The 1/18 models are the cheapest way in: the Ascent-18 crawler is $129.99 ready to run, against $229.95 for the 1/10 Everest Gen7 Sport. The licensed lowriders cost more because of their detailed bodies and extra servos: the 1/10 SixtyFour uses four servos and a 6-channel radio with lowrider controls. Spare parts are sold on the same store, which matters for vehicles that get driven hard. Since only unused items can go back, decide on the scale before you open the box.

If you want a racing kit to build and tune, look at the specs closely, since most of the lineup is ready to run.

faq: Is Redcat Racing legit?
Yes. It's an RC car company in Phoenix, Arizona, with a published address, phone number, refund policy and one-year limited warranty, and a dealer network of hobby shops.
Is Redcat a good RC brand?

Its vehicles come ready to run, carry a one-year limited warranty and have spare parts and manuals on the same store. Redcat's store doesn't show customer ratings, so check owner reviews of the exact model before you buy.

We couldn't load Trustpilot's page for redcatracing.com when we checked on November 13, 2026, and the store shows no ratings of its own, so we don't give a score here.
How old is Redcat Racing?
Redcat's own giveaway page says the brand turned 20 on May 5, 2025.
Where is Redcat Racing based?
Phoenix, Arizona. The store lists its address on East Washington Street in Phoenix.
What does Redcat Racing sell?
Ready-to-run RC rock crawlers, monster trucks, trail trucks and hopping lowriders in 1/18, 1/16 and 1/10 scale, plus batteries, chargers, spare parts and upgrades.
What is the cheapest Redcat RC car?
Among the vehicles we checked, the Volcano-16 1/16 monster truck at $119.95 and the Ascent-18 1/18 crawler at $129.99, both ready to run.
What warranty does Redcat Racing give?
A one-year limited warranty. Claims are handled through Redcat Racing, not the hobby dealer you bought from.
What is Redcat Racing's return policy?
30 days from purchase for unused, complete items in the original packaging, started by email for an RMA. You pay return shipping, and shipping costs aren't refunded.
